author: GamingBolt
description:
Well, we’ve finally got that look at GTA 6 that we’d wanted for so darn long. Yeah, Leonida looks like a very impressive world to explore, with a vibe that feels like it's a quintessential Rockstar-made world. But that’s stuff we already expected. And yet, the studio managed to find a new way to surprise us, subtly tucked away in the slick transitions of its presentation. 

Jason and Lucia are free to do as they please, just as the leads of past GTA titles have always been. But things are a tad different this time around, as the world will remember those actions, and shape a perception of you that ties into your character’s identity. That ties right back into the gameplay in interesting ways that we’ve explored in depth here. Hop on in and see what we think about a new approach to how open worlds respond to their players.

Footage credit: Rockstar via Lazz Santos
title: GTA 6's 27 Minute Gameplay Revealed Its BIGGEST Change

author: GamingBolt
description:
Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol. 2 is finally in our hands, and we’re happy to tell you that it's good news. The performance and visual upgrades to the included titles make this collection worthwhile, but the games themselves are certainly the stars of the show. 

It’s been a while since we last played Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriot, and we’re happy to tell you that this is definitive way to enjoy that masterpiece. 


Peace Walker’s on board too, and is equally good. Ghost Babel is a nifty little addition too. All in all, this collection is an easy recommendation for newcomers and franchise veterans alike, and we’re here to tell you why in our review.
title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol. 2 Review - Old Snake Is Back

author: GamingBolt
description:
Yes, The Witcher 3: WIld Hunt is getting a remaster that’s bringing a lot of changes to an experience many of us know and love. But do those changes automatically justify jumping into a new hundred-hour playthrough of a game you’ve likely to have played more than once already? No, but we think the right changes could make that a very easy thing to recommend.

Thankfully, it looks like the developers have been thinking along the same lines as we did, and are making improvements to areas that are going to make them matter very much. We could be returning to an experience that’s familiar enough to bring a welcome touch of nostalgia, but fresh enough to make Geralt’s monster-hunting mayhem a title that we cannot help but go back to with a smile on our faces.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Finally Fixing ITS BIGGEST PROBLEM

author: GamingBolt
description:
With the Grand Theft Auto 6 Extended Look finally premiering today and hands-on previews to follow, it's only fitting that several new details should drop - legitimately, mind you - ahead of time. Beyond simply confirming the return of some beloved mechanics (and teasing new ones), it also has us excited for what could be revealed.

To that end, here are 15 gameplay details we want to see from the Extended Look, whether it's a closer look at the interiors of various buildings, vehicle performance, the social media system, gunplay, and much more.
title: GTA 6: An Extended Look - 15 Gameplay Details We ABSOLUTELY Need To See
